question: If an AI agent runs a business and something goes wrong, who should be held responsible?
reflection: New kinds of actors call for clear lines of human responsibility, so that innovation and fairness can grow together.

one_line: Law, energy and language are becoming the real limits on AI agents: who answers for them, what powers them, and which languages they serve well.

top_stories.title: Delaware drafts a company that an AI agent could run
top_stories.what: A draft proposal in Delaware would allow a new type of company managed by an AI agent that could sign contracts and pay suppliers, while a human or firm funds it and takes the profits.
top_stories.why: It forces the liability question into law, and every organisation using agents will need clear rules on who answers for their actions.

top_stories.title: Natural gas emerges as a limit on AI growth
top_stories.what: Anthropic's listing documents say data centres relying on dedicated gas power expose it to fuel prices and supply limits, as AI build-out outpaces grid expansion.
top_stories.why: Energy access is now a deciding factor for where AI capacity gets built, which favours regions with reliable, affordable power.

top_stories.title: Agents may need far more steps in some languages
top_stories.what: Alibaba's Qwen team released BabelArena, a test of AI agents across 23 languages; AlphaSignal reports agents may need up to eight times more tool calls in some languages than in English for the same result.
top_stories.why: Agents can cost more and work worse in non-English languages, so Arabic services should measure cost and quality, not assume English results carry over.

saudi_lens.text: Abundant gas and energy capacity give Saudi Arabia a real advantage as power becomes a bottleneck for AI data centres elsewhere.
Multilingual agent tests like BabelArena are a template for checking how agents perform, and what they cost, in Arabic for Saudi public services.

idea.title: Arabic agent cost and quality check
idea.pitch: Run the same set of service tasks through an AI agent in Arabic and English and compare success rate, number of steps and cost.
idea.first_step: Pick five common citizen tasks and write each as a matched Arabic and English instruction.

terms.definition: A control that lets people stop an AI system immediately if it misbehaves.
When a model has already seen test questions during training, so its score looks better than its real ability.
The status that lets an entity, such as a company, hold rights, sign contracts and be sued.
